title: Secure HTML Tag Verifier
description: You are building a lightweight text editor that validates whether HTML-style formatting tags are correctly opened and closed. A string containing only the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']' is given. Determine if the input string is valid. Open brackets must be closed by the same type of brackets, in the correct order, and every close bracket must have a corresponding open bracket of the same type.
input_format: A string s containing bracket characters.
output_format: A boolean value (true or false) indicating validity.

examples.explanation: Multiple valid consecutive pairs of different bracket types.
Mismatched bracket types cannot close each other.
